editorialNote: Preconditions and productions for this beat live in StoryBeat (Sources/StoryEngine/Domain) — the engine is the single source. Page 8, always beside warm_close. The child takes something away. The takeaway should be the NOTICING, not the object (catalog I-1 §B.4 p8) — a habit of looking, a question saved for tomorrow, a promise made to nobody. An object is allowed but must carry a meaning, never be a reward or payment for helping.
